plan.title: Price-based auction minimum revisions for best price

steps.note: Open the single-stage creation flow required for a price-based auction.
Configure the event as a price-based auction.
Provide the required event title before publishing.
Apply a pricing template before adding line items.
Add one line item so the auction can be published and bid on.
Complete the pricing sheet for the line item.
Commit a bidding schedule required for publication.
Invite the QA vendor who will submit and revise the bid.
Publish the auction so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal to observe vendor-side visibility.
Open the auction's pricing round in the vendor portal.
Submit the vendor's initial price before revising it.
Check the vendor view before a revision threshold is reached; this is the closest available visibility assertion.
Submit one revision from the same vendor.
Check whether Best Price remains hidden after fewer than the intended threshold of revisions.
